list_records.title: List records
list_records.description: Page through a datasheet's records, up to 1,000 per page. Filter with filter_by_formula (e.g. {Status}="Done"), restrict columns with fields, or fetch specific rows with record_ids. Returns total, pageNum, pageSize and the records.

datasheet_id.description: The datasheet id (starts with dst), from the datasheet's URL or list_nodes.

view_id.description: View id (starts with viw). Uses that view's filters, sort and hidden fields.

max_records.description: Stop after this many records in total.

record_ids.description: Only these record ids, returned in the order given (up to 1,000).

fields.description: Only return these fields, by name (or id when field_key is id).

filter_by_formula.description: Formula deciding which records come back.

cell_format.description: json (default) for typed values or string for display text.

field_key.description: Whether `fields` are keyed by field name (default) or by field id; ids survive renames.

output.description: A page of records with paging totals.

records.description: Each with recordId, createdAt, updatedAt and fields.

create_records.title: Create records
create_records.description: Add up to 10 records to a datasheet in one call. Each item is {"fields": {...}} keyed by field name (or id when field_key is id). Returns the created records with their recordIds.

datasheet_id.description: The datasheet id (starts with dst), from the datasheet's URL or list_nodes.

field_key.description: Whether `fields` are keyed by field name (default) or by field id; ids survive renames.

view_id.description: View id (starts with viw). Uses that view's filters, sort and hidden fields.

update_records.title: Update records
update_records.description: Change fields on up to 10 existing records. Each item is {"recordId": "rec...", "fields": {...}}; only the fields named are written. Set a field to null to clear it.

datasheet_id.description: The datasheet id (starts with dst), from the datasheet's URL or list_nodes.

field_key.description: Whether `fields` are keyed by field name (default) or by field id; ids survive renames.

view_id.description: View id (starts with viw). Uses that view's filters, sort and hidden fields.

delete_records.title: Delete records
delete_records.description: Permanently delete up to 10 records from a datasheet by id.

datasheet_id.description: The datasheet id (starts with dst), from the datasheet's URL or list_nodes.

record_ids.description: Ids of the records to delete (up to 10).

list_fields.title: List fields
list_fields.description: Read a datasheet's fields (columns): id, name, type, whether editable and type-specific properties such as select options. Call it before writing records to learn exact field names and types.

datasheet_id.description: The datasheet id (starts with dst), from the datasheet's URL or list_nodes.

view_id.description: View id (starts with viw). Uses that view's filters, sort and hidden fields.

fields.description: Each with id, name, type, editable, property.

create_field.title: Create a field
create_field.description: Add a field (column) to a datasheet. `type` is a field type such as SingleText, Text, Number, SingleSelect, MultiSelect, DateTime, Checkbox, Member or OneWayLink; most types need `property` (e.g. {options: [{name: 'Todo'}]} for selects).

space_id.description: The space id (starts with spc), from list_spaces.

datasheet_id.description: The datasheet id (starts with dst), from the datasheet's URL or list_nodes.

type.description: Field type, e.g. SingleText, Number, SingleSelect, DateTime, Checkbox.

property.description: Type-specific settings, as described under Field Types and Attributes.

output.description: The created field's id and name.

delete_field.title: Delete a field
delete_field.description: Delete a field and all the values stored in it. The primary field cannot be deleted. For a two-way link, `conversion` decides what happens to the linked field in the other datasheet.

space_id.description: The space id (starts with spc), from list_spaces.

datasheet_id.description: The datasheet id (starts with dst), from the datasheet's URL or list_nodes.

conversion.description: For link fields: delete the related field too, or keepText to convert it to text.

list_views.title: List views
list_views.description: List a datasheet's views with their id, name and type (Grid, Gallery, Kanban, Gantt, Calendar, Architecture).

datasheet_id.description: The datasheet id (starts with dst), from the datasheet's URL or list_nodes.

create_datasheet.title: Create a datasheet
create_datasheet.description: Create a new datasheet in a space, optionally inside a folder and with an initial set of fields. Without `fields`, a default structure is created.

space_id.description: The space id (starts with spc), from list_spaces.

folder_id.description: Folder to create it in (fod...); defaults to the space's root.

pre_node_id.description: Place the datasheet after this node in the folder.

output.description: The new datasheet's id, creation time and fields.

list_spaces.title: List spaces
list_spaces.description: List the spaces the API token's user belongs to, with each space's id, name and whether the user is its admin. The space id is needed for nodes, fields and member tools.

list_nodes.title: List a space's top-level nodes
list_nodes.description: List the files at the root of a space's working directory: datasheets, folders, forms, dashboards and mirrors, with id, name, type and permission. Use get_node to open a folder's children, or search_nodes to find nodes by type or name.

space_id.description: The space id (starts with spc), from list_spaces.

nodes.description: Each with id, name, type, icon, isFav, permission.

search_nodes.title: Search nodes
search_nodes.description: Find nodes anywhere in a space by type, required permission level and name. For example type Datasheet with permissions 0,1 lists every datasheet the user can manage or edit.

space_id.description: The space id (starts with spc), from list_spaces.

permissions.description: Permission levels to include: 0 manager, 1 editor, 2 update-only, 3 read-only. Defaults to 0,1,2,3.

query.description: Only nodes whose name contains this text.

nodes.description: Each with id, name, type, permission.

get_node.title: Get a node
get_node.description: Read one node's details: name, type, permission and, for a folder, its child nodes.

space_id.description: The space id (starts with spc), from list_spaces.

node_id.description: The node id: a datasheet (dst...), folder (fod...), form, dashboard or mirror id, from list_nodes.

output.description: The node, with children for folders.

create_embed_link.title: Create an embed link
create_embed_link.description: Create an embeddable link for a datasheet, dashboard or form so it can be shown inside another site. `payload` controls which UI parts (sidebar, toolbars, view tabs) appear and whether editing is allowed. Up to 30 links per node.

space_id.description: The space id (starts with spc), from list_spaces.

node_id.description: The node id: a datasheet (dst...), folder (fod...), form, dashboard or mirror id, from list_nodes.

payload.description: Embed UI settings: editable, primarySideBar, viewControl (viewId, tabBar, toolBar, collapsed), bannerLogo, permissionType.

theme.description: Colour theme of the embedded page.

list_embed_links.title: List embed links
list_embed_links.description: List the embed links created for a node, each with its id, URL, payload and theme.

space_id.description: The space id (starts with spc), from list_spaces.

node_id.description: The node id: a datasheet (dst...), folder (fod...), form, dashboard or mirror id, from list_nodes.

delete_embed_link.title: Delete an embed link
delete_embed_link.description: Delete an embed link; pages embedding it stop loading immediately.

space_id.description: The space id (starts with spc), from list_spaces.

node_id.description: The node id: a datasheet (dst...), folder (fod...), form, dashboard or mirror id, from list_nodes.

link_id.description: The embed link id (starts with emb).

create_ai_chat_completion.title: Chat with an AI agent
create_ai_chat_completion.description: Send messages to an AITable AI agent and get its reply in OpenAI chat-completion format. The agent answers from the datasets it was trained on in AITable.

ai_id.description: The AI agent's id (starts with ai_).

model.description: Model name, as configured for the agent.

messages.description: Conversation so far, each {role: system|user|assistant, content}.

user.description: An id for the end user, for abuse monitoring.

get_member.title: Get a member
get_member.description: Read one member of a space: name, avatar, status and the teams and roles they belong to. Enterprise plans; needs contact-management permission.

space_id.description: The space id (starts with spc), from list_spaces.

unit_id.description: The unit id of the member, team or role.

sensitive_data.description: true returns the member's phone and email unmasked (needs the matching admin permission).

output.description: The member with teams and roles.

update_member.title: Update a member
update_member.description: Change a member's display name and replace the teams and roles they belong to. Lists you send replace the current ones. Enterprise plans.

space_id.description: The space id (starts with spc), from list_spaces.

unit_id.description: The unit id of the member, team or role.

teams.description: Unit ids of the teams the member should belong to.

roles.description: Unit ids of the roles the member should hold.

sensitive_data.description: true returns the member's phone and email unmasked (needs the matching admin permission).

delete_member.title: Remove a member
delete_member.description: Remove a member from a space. They lose access to everything in it. Enterprise plans.

space_id.description: The space id (starts with spc), from list_spaces.

unit_id.description: The unit id of the member, team or role.

list_team_members.title: List a team's members
list_team_members.description: List the members directly in a team. Use unit id 0 for the root team. Enterprise plans.

space_id.description: The space id (starts with spc), from list_spaces.

unit_id.description: The unit id of the member, team or role.

sensitive_data.description: true returns the member's phone and email unmasked (needs the matching admin permission).

list_team_children.title: List a team's sub-teams
list_team_children.description: List the teams directly under a team. Use unit id 0 for the root to list top-level teams. Enterprise plans.

space_id.description: The space id (starts with spc), from list_spaces.

unit_id.description: The unit id of the member, team or role.

create_team.title: Create a team
create_team.description: Create a team in a space, optionally under a parent team and with roles attached. Enterprise plans.

space_id.description: The space id (starts with spc), from list_spaces.

parent_unit_id.description: Unit id of the parent team; defaults to the root.

roles.description: Unit ids of roles to attach to the team.

update_team.title: Update a team
update_team.description: Rename a team, move it under another parent, reorder it or replace its roles. Enterprise plans.

space_id.description: The space id (starts with spc), from list_spaces.

unit_id.description: The unit id of the member, team or role.

parent_unit_id.description: Unit id of the new parent team.

roles.description: Unit ids of the roles the team should hold.

delete_team.title: Delete a team
delete_team.description: Delete a team. It must have no members and no sub-teams. Enterprise plans.

space_id.description: The space id (starts with spc), from list_spaces.

unit_id.description: The unit id of the member, team or role.

list_roles.title: List roles
list_roles.description: List the roles defined in a space with their unit id, name and sequence. Enterprise plans.

space_id.description: The space id (starts with spc), from list_spaces.

list_role_units.title: List a role's members and teams
list_role_units.description: List the members and teams that hold a role. Enterprise plans.

space_id.description: The space id (starts with spc), from list_spaces.

unit_id.description: The unit id of the member, team or role.

sensitive_data.description: true returns the member's phone and email unmasked (needs the matching admin permission).

create_role.title: Create a role
create_role.description: Create a role in a space. Assign it to members with update_member or to teams with update_team. Enterprise plans.

space_id.description: The space id (starts with spc), from list_spaces.

update_role.title: Update a role
update_role.description: Rename a role or change its position in the list. Enterprise plans.

space_id.description: The space id (starts with spc), from list_spaces.

unit_id.description: The unit id of the member, team or role.

delete_role.title: Delete a role
delete_role.description: Delete a role. It must not be assigned to any member or team. Enterprise plans.

space_id.description: The space id (starts with spc), from list_spaces.

unit_id.description: The unit id of the member, team or role.
